entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A powerful human barbarian from the Pardic Mountains of Otaria, a pit-fighter who pursues, wields and finally renounces the Mirari, and later fights Karona.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, wounded by him, later turned into Phage by the Cabal Patriarch, and finally freed to oblivion after closing the rift over Otaria.

entities.name: Balthor
entities.description: Kamahl's mentor, a dwarf who sacrifices himself, is zombified by Braids, and is struck down by Kamahl.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A Cabal dementia caster and Kamahl's friend, driven mad and killed by the Mirari.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A centaur druid and friend of Kamahl who guides him into the Krosan forest.

entities.name: Lieutenant Kirtar
entities.description: An arrogant aven warrior of the Order who claims Kamahl's dragon kill and chooses the Mirari as his prize.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A Mer Empire ambassador obsessed with the Mirari and Kamahl's long-time rival.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A Cabal agent who sorts artifacts for the Empire, retrieves the Mirari, zombifies Balthor and kidnaps Jeska.

entities.name: Stonebrow
entities.description: Kamahl's friend who revives him from meditation and travels the world with him after the wars.

entities.name: Thriss
entities.description: An ancient nantuko in Krosa who teaches Kamahl the druidic way of life.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: A warrior who comes to avenge Nivea's death, fights Kamahl and Jeska, and is merged into Karona.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A radiant being born when Phage, Akroma and Zagorka die together; Otaria worships her until Kamahl and others kill her.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: A woman whose life is taken by the Soul Reaper along with Phage and Akroma, helping to form Karona.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Ruler of the dream-made realm Topos, on whom Kamahl declares war.

entities.name: Matoc
entities.description: Kamahl's grandfather, a legendary lavamancer.

entities.name: Baru
entities.description: A man who will in the future take up Kamahl's title of the Fist of Krosa.

entities.name: Emperor Aboshan
entities.description: The Mer Empire's emperor who uses the Mirari to cause a tidal wave that devastates northern Otaria.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A powerful magical artifact whose influence obsesses and corrupts those who pursue it; Kamahl attaches it to his sword's pommel.

entities.name: Soul Reaper
entities.description: An axe made from the Patriarch's old axe and the broken halves of Kamahl's druid staff, symbol of the Cabal-Krosa alliance.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The organization based in Cabal City that runs the pit fights and is led by the Patriarch.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: Leader of the Cabal who insists Kamahl throw a match and turns Jeska into Phage.

entities.name: The Order
entities.description: A faction devoted to destroying dangerous magical devices, based in a citadel.

entities.name: Mer Empire
entities.description: The merfolk empire to which the Mirari is taken.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: City where pit-fighting takes place and where Kamahl begins his career.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: The Krosan forest, where Kamahl renounces the Mirari and becomes a druid.

entities.name: Sanctum
entities.description: The great city where Phage and Akroma fight and where Karona is born and later killed.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Region of Dominaria that is Kamahl's home.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Otaria lies.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: War in which the Cabal and the Krosan forest march on Ixidor's realm of Topos.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: The war that follows Karona's birth and ends with her death.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: The event that begins after Jeska closes the rift in Otaria's skies.

events.summary: Kamahl leaves his mountain home for Cabal City to seek wealth and fame as a pit-fighter.
events.quote: He left his mountain home to go to Cabal City to earn himself wealth and fame through pit-fighting.

events.summary: Kamahl wins sponsorship and enters the pits, first sees the Mirari and befriends Seton and Chainer.
events.quote: He first saw the Mirari when he was shown the fighters' prizes and became obsessed with obtaining them.

events.summary: Kamahl kills a Krosan dragon attacking Cabal City but Lieutenant Kirtar is credited and takes the Mirari as his prize, starting the Battle for the Mirari.
events.quote: Kamahl thus began his journey to claim the artifact for himself.

events.summary: Kirtar uses the Mirari to crystallize much of the Order's fortress, including himself and Captain Pianna; Laquatus ends up with the Mirari.
events.quote: Kirtar used the device to cast a devastating spell that crystallized much of the fortress

events.summary: Emperor Aboshan uses the Mirari to cause a tidal wave that devastates northern Otaria while Kamahl trains youths in Breaker Bay.
events.quote: Emperor Aboshan used the Mirari to cause a tidal wave that devastated the northern third of Otaria.

events.summary: Kamahl returns to Cabal City, partners with Chainer for a record winning streak and refuses the Patriarch's order to throw a match.
events.quote: Kamahl refused, as he wanted to win or lose games by his skill rather than on the whims of match-fixers.

events.summary: Kamahl accompanies Chainer on his ritual shikar and they fight off an ambushing druid and animals.
events.quote: Kamahl and Chainer won the fight, but afterward, Kamahl felt a great deal of guilt

events.summary: Kamahl is badly hurt in the Order's attack on Cabal City and wakes with snakeskin grafted by Chainer using the Mirari; he burns it off.
events.quote: To cleanse himself of the additions, Kamahl burnt off his skin and left the hospital

events.summary: The Mirari drives Chainer mad and warps him into a mass of dementia beasts; dying, he gives the Mirari to Kamahl, who attaches it to his sword.
events.quote: As Chainer died, he gave the Mirari to Kamahl

events.summary: Kamahl returns home, is dominated by the Mirari and tries to take all the tribes under his dictatorship, dividing the barbarians.
events.quote: Initially, he was content simply to return home covered in glory, but inevitably, the Mirari dominated his mind.

events.summary: In battle Kamahl impales Jeska with the Mirari-sword, leaving an incurable wound; shocked, he resolves to be rid of the Mirari.
events.quote: Kamahl viciously impaling Jeska with his Mirari-sword

events.summary: Attacked at the edge of the Krosan forest, Balthor sacrifices himself so Kamahl can flee with Jeska; Seton guides Kamahl in and Thriss teaches him druidism.
events.quote: Balthor chose to sacrifice himself to let Kamahl flee with Jeska.

events.summary: Laquatus mind-controls zombified Balthor into fighting Kamahl, who is forced to strike down his old mentor at Balthor's plea.
events.quote: Balthor begged Kamahl to end his torment, and so Kamahl was forced to strike down his old mentor.

events.summary: Kamahl strikes down Laquatus with the Mirari-sword, leaves it in the ground and forsakes the Mirari for a druidic life.
events.quote: With that act, Kamahl forsook the Mirari and his violent past

events.summary: Braids kidnaps Jeska, and the Cabal Patriarch turns her into Phage; Kamahl and Phage fight until Akroma interrupts and they defeat her together.
events.quote: who tried to kill her, but instead turned her into Phage

events.summary: Kamahl declares war on Ixidor and leads the Cabal and Krosan alliance against Topos in the Nightmare War, defeating his Mirari-possessed persona.
events.quote: Kamahl led the joint forces into battle

events.summary: Deathwurms are purged from Phage, but Kamahl must watch his sister become Phage again to bind them.
events.quote: was forced to watch his sister become Phage once again.

events.summary: Kamahl meditates in Krosa for a year until Stonebrow revives him with the Soul Reaper.
events.quote: Green energy flowed from Soul Reaper to Kamahl, who was revitalized

events.summary: Kamahl swings the Soul Reaper in Sanctum, killing Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, whose merged souls become Karona.
events.quote: the axe claimed Phage and Akroma's lives, as well as an unexpected third life

events.summary: Kamahl meets Karona, then resolves she must be stopped; he retrieves the Mirari from Laquatus's corpse with Balthor's ghost's help.
events.quote: it was only through Balthor's spiritual sacrifice that Kamahl managed to gain control over the Mirari-sword

events.summary: Kamahl and the numena confront Karona in Sanctum; Karona and the numena are killed.
events.quote: In a final confrontation, both Karona and the numena were killed.

events.summary: Much later Jeska closes the rift in Otaria's skies, and the dead Kamahl welcomes her in a white void.
events.quote: Jeska sacrificed herself to close the rift in Otaria's skies, allowing the Great Mending to begin.
